sc_cortisol_pro.name: Cortisol Pro
sc_cortisol_pro.key: Per 2 capsules: 300 mg maral root, 250 mg Relora, 250 mg rhodiola, 150 mg ashwagandha, 100 mg L-theanine, 100 mg phosphatidylserine
sc_cortisol_pro.src: Stress Essentials Cortisol Pro sell sheet ND975 Rev. 2/25 (Dropbox NutriDyn Marketing Materials, read into scratchpad labels/labels.json): per 2 capsules maral root extract (Rhaponticum carthamoides) 300 mg, Relora (Magnolia officinalis and Phellodendron amurense bark extracts) 250 mg, Rhodiola rosea root powder 250 mg, ashwagandha root and leaf extract (Sensoril, 10% withanolides) 150 mg, L-theanine (Suntheanine) 100 mg, phosphatidylserine (from sunflower) 100 mg; 30 servings; directions 'two capsules daily'; caution 'Do not use if pregnant.' Same phosphatidylserine, Sensoril, L-theanine and Relora amounts in products DB R2182 (Integrative Therapeutics and Nutri-West switch charts, catalog ND143 10/1/26). Size: ND144 price list 10/1/26 (R2182 60C). The label gives no time of day; the sheet splits the two capsules between breakfast and dinner. URL nutridyn.com/cortisol-pro seen through web search only (nutridyn.com not opened). Sheet name: the Stress Essentials line prints on the size line and the product name alone above it (as on the bottle, which reads 'Stress Essentials' over the product name), so the daily-rhythm panel stays short.

sc_balance.name: Balance
sc_balance.key: Per 3 capsules: 800 mg cordyceps, 400 mg ashwagandha (Sensoril), 107 mg Asian ginseng extract plus 58 mg ginseng root
sc_balance.src: products DB R123 (11 switch-chart label reads, catalog ND143 10/1/26): per 3 capsules cordyceps extract 800 mg, ashwagandha extract (Sensoril) 400 mg, Asian ginseng extract 107 mg (14% ginsenosides) plus 58 mg powder, rhodiola extract 100 mg (1 mg salidroside, 3 mg rosavins); directions 'three capsules two times daily'; sizes R123 90C and R123L 180C (ND144 price list 10/1/26). A nutridyn.com page variant seen through web search only (not opened) lists Cordyceps militaris and no rhodiola, so the sheet prints only the amounts both versions agree on and leaves rhodiola and the cordyceps species off. Sheet dose is once daily (inside 'or as directed'), so ashwagandha from this plus Cortisol Pro is 550 mg a day, inside the 300-600 mg/day stress range in Akhgarjand 2022 (PMID 36017529). Sheet name: the Stress Essentials line prints on the size line and the product name alone above it (as on the bottle, which reads 'Stress Essentials' over the product name), so the daily-rhythm panel stays short.

sc_adrenal_renew.name: Adrenal Renew
sc_adrenal_renew.key: Per 2 capsules: 300 mg vitamin C, 60 mg B6, 50 mg pantothenic acid, 15 mg zinc, 100 mg L-tyrosine, 300 mg bovine adrenal, 50 mg bovine spleen
sc_adrenal_renew.src: products DB R159 (Ortho Molecular Adren-All, Apex Adreno-Zyme and Standard Process switch-chart label reads, catalog ND143 10/1/26): per 2 capsules bovine adrenal (suprarenal) substance 300 mg, vitamin C 300 mg, vitamin B6 60 mg, pantothenic acid 50 mg, zinc 15 mg, L-tyrosine 100 mg, bovine spleen 50 mg; directions 'two capsules daily'; size 60C (ND144 price list 10/1/26). The nutridyn.com page (seen through web search only, not opened) also lists thiamine 50 mg, riboflavin 15 mg and holy basil 200 mg; those are not in the DB read, so the sheet does not print them. Sheet name: the Stress Essentials line prints on the size line and the product name alone above it (as on the bottle, which reads 'Stress Essentials' over the product name), so the daily-rhythm panel stays short.

sc_mag_calm_pro.name: Mag Calm Pro
sc_mag_calm_pro.key: Per scoop: 200 mg magnesium, 2 g myo-inositol, 500 mg taurine, 100 mg L-theanine, 5 mg vitamin B6
sc_mag_calm_pro.src: Mag Calm Pro sell sheet ND1075 Rev. 11/24 (labels.json): per scoop (4.13 g) vitamin B6 (as P5P) 5 mg, magnesium (as dimagnesium malate) 200 mg, myo-inositol 2 g, taurine 500 mg, L-theanine (Suntheanine) 100 mg; about 60 servings, 247.8 g; directions 'Mix 1 scoop with 6 ounces of water 1-2 times daily'. Same amounts in products DB R2122 (Metagenics chart, catalog ND143 10/1/26). URL seen through web search only.
